relationship: Two ingredient flow rates jointly set mixture ratio and total throughput, while the bottling display makes both consequences visible.

learnerLoop.action: Tune the concentrate and water pumps, then complete the linked rate calculations.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The mixture composition, total flow and bottle filling update.
learnerLoop.evidence: Pump settings, mixer monitor, bottle output and answer checks show whether the target is met.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose which flow rate to change to satisfy the ratio or throughput requirement.

invariants: Total flow is the sum of the two ingredient flows.
A mixture ratio depends on the relative ingredient flows, not their display order.
safeAdaptations: Vary achievable recipe ratios, flows and bottle targets.
Adjust calculation scaffolding while retaining separate composition and throughput evidence.
nonGoals: Treating ratio and total flow as interchangeable quantities.

task.description: Current target recipe, target volume and dwell requirement.
task.visibility: Shown for the current blending case.

model.description: Blending plant, recipe bars, fill monitor and bottles update from the two pump flows.
model.visibility: Present throughout the case; result bottle is populated after a release.

working.description: Working-level calculation fields for total flow and then the two component flows.
working.visibility: Always present; dynamic fields appear at Working Some or All.

evidence.description: Live ratio, predicted fill, target line, under/overfill status and released bottle expose the checks.
evidence.visibility: Monitor is shown while adjusting; result evidence appears after a release.

completion.description: Solved state and next problem action.
completion.visibility: Shown only when ratio, fill and selected working checks pass.

settings.description: Working support level and case reset.
settings.visibility: Working level controls are shown for the current case.

inputs.description: Two pump sliders and later total/component answer fields.
inputs.visibility: Sliders are present throughout; generated answer fields depend on Working level.

pump-flows.description: Concentrate and water flow rates, kept as separate physical pump slots.
pump-flows.domain: Litres per minute; sliders use 0.1 L/min steps.
pump-flows.source: Learner adjusts #concFlow and #waterFlow; some/all also expose the corresponding calculation fields.
pump-flows.output: Pump readouts, current recipe bars and current recipe text.

total-flow.description: Sum of the two ingredient flow rates used for throughput.
total-flow.source: Computed from both pumps; Working Some/All supplies a generated total field.

composition.description: Concentrate share and concentrate:water ratio; this is independent of total flow.
composition.source: Computed from nonzero pump settings and the generated target recipe.

throughput.description: Required total flow and resulting bottle volume over the fixed dwell.
throughput.domain: Litres per minute and litres; dwell is in seconds converted to minutes.
throughput.source: Target recipe scale and dwell generated for the case.

modes.none: Existing Off level: the two pump sliders are available and the calculation is shown in the working dock.
modes.some: Existing Some level: a generated total-flow answer is required before the two component answer fields are used.
modes.all: Existing All level: generated total, concentrate and water fields must agree with the target; the pump sliders are disabled while component answers are checked.
modes.progression: Solved counts are tracked per working level; after three solves at a level the next level is offered. These labels describe source controls, not inferred curriculum.

dependencies: A release is solved only when the pump ratio is correct, predicted bottle volume equals the target, and the selected working-level fields are correct.
At Some/All, the total answer must be correct before component fields are unlocked; changing flows recalculates ratio and fill evidence.
#nextProblem advances only from the solved state; #resetCase starts a fresh generated case.
The existing reset action is in the model-tools row below the mission and global settings.
implementation.completion: The source solved() check requires ratioCorrect, fillCorrect and workingComplete. A solved release shows #nextCard and permits #nextProblem; level-up is offered after three solved cases at the current level.
limitations: Recipe ratios, scales and dwell values are generated from fixed attainable cases; slider values are quantised to 0.1 L/min.
Total/component working fields are dynamically generated under #totalFields and #pumpFields and have no stable per-field IDs.
